_purpose: Golden vectors for the per-model price resolution (data/prices.json model_overrides). Companion to tests/methodology-vectors.json, which stays the family-level contract and is kept byte-identical because downstream consumers compare it byte for byte. Any change to model_overrides, to the family prices or factors, or to the matching rule MUST update these expected values in the same commit.
_formulas: Same co2_grams and cost_usd formulas as tests/methodology-vectors.json, with price_in, price_out and the three cache multipliers taken from the model's override when one matches, from the family and the global multipliers otherwise. Emission factors are always the family's.
_matching: An override key matches the model id exactly, or as a prefix followed only by a dated snapshot suffix -YYYYMMDD; a trailing context marker such as [1m] is ignored; the longest matching key wins. claude-opus-5-50 is the bounded-prefix negative case: it must NOT pick up the claude-opus-5-5 override.
_sources: platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, read 2026-09-23 (USD per Mtok): Opus 5.5 4/20, cache read 0.20; Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 10/50, cache read 0.25; Fable 5 10/50, cache read 1; Opus 5 5/25; Sonnet 5 2/10; Sonnet 4.6 and 4.5 3/15; Haiku 4.5 1/5.
_token_semantics: As in tests/methodology-vectors.json: input_tokens is the UNCACHED input, cache_creation_tokens the cache write, cache_creation_1h_tokens its 1-hour subset (optional, default 0).
_rounding: Token counts are multiples of 10,000, so every expected value is exact at <= 3 decimals for co2_grams and <= 4 decimals for cost_usd. Runners compare with a relative tolerance of 1e-6.

vectors.description: Opus 5.5, cache writes at the 1-hour tier, cache reads at 0.05x input

A trailing [1m] context marker does not hide the override

Opus 5 has no override: family price, same tokens as the negative case
Mythos 5.1 alias, cache reads and output only
Fable 5 keeps the family cache read at 0.1x: same tokens as Mythos 5.1, twice the cost
Sonnet 4.6 at 3/15, no longer billed at the Sonnet 5 family price
Sonnet 5 at the family price 2/10, same tokens as Sonnet 4.6
Dated Sonnet 4.5 id picks up its 3/15 override
Haiku 4.5 has no override: family price 1/5
